findings.summary: The new case makes the suite 22 cases, but docs/guide/evals.md still says 21. G4 updates the guide's /vloop:plan row and the README catalogue, not this count. A work session that fixes it touches a line the contract does not name, and one that leaves it ships a stale doc.
findings.evidence: docs/guide/evals.md:133: 'The full suite is 21 cases × 3 runs × 2 arms'. ls plugin/evals: 10 review cases (01–08, 05b, 07b) + 11 others = 21 directories.
findings.fix: In G4, add: in docs/guide/evals.md, '21 cases' becomes '22 cases'. Add a worked-example line: joined docs/guide/evals.md contains 'The full suite is 22 cases'.

findings.summary: Unsure. The acceptance asks for 'one run each', but the guide's invocation implies 3 runs per case ('21 cases × 3 runs'), and the brief names no flag for the run count. It cites --case from the tool's help but not this flag.
findings.evidence: docs/guide/evals.md:104-116 (the invocation, with no run-count flag) and :133. This review could not run 'claude plugin eval --help' (the call was denied), so it could not confirm the flag's name or whether the default is 3.
findings.fix: Name the run-count flag, taken from 'claude plugin eval --help', next to --case. Or say that one run per case is the tool's default for this invocation.

decisions: Change the plan skill, not the gate review's standard (pins-unnamed stays as is). Agree: the gate review was right in the 2026-11-02 attempt.
A pin stays allowed where no surface the brief names reaches a criterion, and the pinned name goes into the task's acceptance. Agree: forbidding every pin turns such criteria into uncovered findings.

G2 tells the planner to change every task a finding names until the finding no longer holds. The plan skill gives the planner no way to dispute a gate-review finding, so a false finding (like B26's false unpassable) now pushes the planner to rewrite a sound gate. Probably acceptable, because a second failure still stops the run for the operator, but the operator should know.
gpt-6.1-terra is the only candidate; gpt-6-luna, claude-sonnet-5.5 through Copilot and kimi-k3 are deferred to #81.
Qualifying gpt-6.1-terra is the operator's acceptance at close, and #84 closes only if every phase qualifies.
The gate-review ceiling rises from 1550 to 1600. The estimated size after G3 is about 1556 words, which leaves about 44 words of headroom.
The eval's library is a shell library, so the case needs nothing but sh.

The eval's brief requires 'its verify command alone, with no file in a gate folder', so the llm grader (focused on state.json only) sees every judge. This narrows what the case tests, because the planner's gate-folder path is not exercised. Fine for this case.
No domain invariant changes: P-4 and P-8 stand, and the pin rule lives in the skills.
